reasons: Selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but redis.commands.processed is a monotonic sum in the dataset (dataset_types: sum), so the selector matches no series.
The $host template variable has prefix host and default *, so it must become host=~"$host"; the candidate drops it, which changes the series filter.

The Datadog query has no rollup or function; sum(rate(...)) matches the 'per second' title only if the Datadog series is a cumulative count, so the rate step should be confirmed against the Datadog semantics.
The quantity (commands processed) and the monotonic-sum rate usage are otherwise consistent with the OTel definition, and the $scope variable is correctly dropped.
Dataset label keys do not include host, so the host matcher may need to be checked against observed labels before emitting it.
